notes.title: Final 2024 update
notes.notes:
The colors of the countries are made more contrasting:

https://i.ibb.co/wRgZ9fJ/Warsystemupdate-Screenshot-2024-12-25-22-05-45-71.png

The mercenary button has been moved to the call window

https://i.ibb.co/9rrytJt/Warsystemupdate-Screenshot-2024-12-25-22-05-54-12.png

Reworked mechanics of wars. From now on, war does not happen immediately, and countries can lose.

https://i.ibb.co/nrrRZr5/Warsystemupdate-Screenshot-2024-12-25-22-08-27-04.png

notes.title: Week 9 update
notes.notes:
Changes:
- the date of bot aggression has been changed. Before that, they were all fascinating exactly at the beginning of the year. With a change, they will capture at a random moment.
- added mercenaries. They do not need to be trained and they do not need equipment in the warehouse, but they cost 10 times more

https://i.ibb.co/HC1GcrQ/2024-12-18-190117.png

- added mini windows when hovering over countries in which its power is shown

https://i.ibb.co/1MqsRn5/2024-12-18-190141.png

- fixed movement of the camera when pressing the middle mouse button
- the countries window has been made more convenient

https://i.ibb.co/PNFc3T7/2024-12-18-190200.png

- redesigned appearance of the country selection screen

https://i.ibb.co/jHRWTCZ/2024-12-18-190013.png

- redesigned capture notifications. They are now smaller and in the corner of the screen, and disappear automatically after 30 days

https://i.ibb.co/kytYRWm/2024-12-18-190410.png
